articles.title: The US army just detonated a poison bomb over Iowa | Steven Donziger
articles.summary_snippet: The shocking situation in Iowa is a metaphor for much of what is wrong with the United States There’s no way to hide it: the US government just deliberately detonated a poison bomb of lead azide over the state of Iowa when a totally safe alternative was available. The problem in Iowa was relatively simple to solve. The army for decades had stored lead underground at a munitions facility. As far back as 2009, the government knew the lead was deteriorating and might blow up on its own. But it procrastinated. Finally, in March, the army hired a Georgia-based company to use a chemical spray to neutralize the lead, creating a non-hazardous byproduct that can be disposed of in landfills. Steven Donziger is a US-based human rights and environmental lawyer and the author of Donziger On Justice on Substack Continue reading...
